title: Why Is AMBULANCE Written Backwards?
description:
Why is the word AMBULANCE written backwards on the front of an ambulance? It isn't a mistake. It's written for one person: the driver stuck right in front of it. When a siren sounds behind you, you don't turn around, you glance up at your rear-view mirror. A mirror flips everything left to right, so a normal word would look backwards. That's why the word is printed flipped: in your mirror it reads AMBULANCE. The official US ambulance specification (KKK-A-1822) even requires the front word to be mirror imaged.

Did you ever notice it?

More true whys: https://www.youtube.com/@truewhys?sub_confirmation=1

Sources: Wikipedia, "Mirror writing"; Hewitt, Conceptual Physics (ch. 28); ScienceABC, "Why mirrors reverse left and right"; GSA KKK-A-1822 Federal Specification for the Star-of-Life Ambulance (front markings).
Animation, music and sound: TrueWhys (original). 3D people made with MPFB / MakeHuman (CC0). Fonts: Lilita One, Poppins (Open Font License).
